_comment: Reviewed-but-not-now decisions for tools/check_dependency_freshness.py. A deferral is for a floor that would genuinely break something if raised right now, with the reason recorded here; it is not a place to park 'waiting for upstream to move first'. Each entry needs deferredLatest so it expires by itself once the registry moves past the release it was reviewed against; a permanent policy belongs on the declaring line as `# freshness-hold:` instead.
